mechanism_narrative: Persistent decline in TRANSIT mobility (-46.0% at t-0w) signals sustained lockdown conditions that suppress retail foot traffic. RETAIL_REC will remain depressed over the next four weeks because commuting and transit-dependent shopping remain constrained.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT declined from -28.3% to -46.0% over three weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT mobility recovers by more than 15 percentage points in any single week over the next four weeks, yet RETAIL_REC does not increase correspondingly.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating RESIDENTIAL mobility increase (8.4% → 19.9% → 14.3% → 15.7%) indicates sustained home confinement behavior. This behavioral shift reduces discretionary retail visits, driving RETAIL_REC further negative over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above 14% for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility drops below 10% while RETAIL_REC simultaneously increases by more than 5 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility stabilization (-29.4% at t-0w, improving from -50.0% at t-2w) combined with TRANSIT recovery signal partial return to commuting. This dual recovery will drive retail footfall upward over the next four weeks through increased weekday shopping.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES increases by more than 10 percentage points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved 20.6 points from t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: Both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT decline further in week t+1w, yet RETAIL_REC increases by more than 8 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM decline (-9.0% at t-0w, worsening from -0.6% at t-3w) indicates essential shopping is being deferred or consolidated. This substitution effect suppresses total discretionary mobility, keeping RETAIL_REC depressed over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -8% in any week
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM declined 10.3 points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM recovers to baseline (0%) while RETAIL_REC remains below -30%.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility remains severely depressed (-29.7% at t-0w) despite being outdoor activity. This indicates weather, policy, or behavioral constraints are binding. If PARKS cannot recover, outdoor-adjacent retail (e.g., shopping precincts) will remain suppressed, keeping RETAIL_REC negative.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains below -25% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS declined from -21.7% to -29.7% over three weeks
failure_condition: PARKS mobility increases by more than 20 percentage points in a single week while RETAIL_REC simultaneously decreases.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between elevated RESIDENTIAL confinement (15.7%) and depressed WORKPLACES (-29.4%) creates a regime where consumers lack both commuting opportunity and discretionary income confidence. RETAIL_REC will decline further as this dual constraint persists over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:Both series show constraint at t-0w
failure_condition: WORKPLACES recovers to -10% or better while RESIDENTIAL remains above 14%, yet RETAIL_REC does not increase by at least 8 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility shows week-on-week improvement (from -50.0% at t-2w to -29.4% at t-0w), signaling employer reopening. This 20.6-point recovery will translate to increased commuter retail spending within one to two weeks as workers resume weekday shopping patterns.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES improves by more than 15 percentage points in a single week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved 20.6 points from t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: WORKPLACES continues to improve in week t+1w but RETAIL_REC declines by more than 5 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: Coordinated collapse across TRANSIT (-46.0%), WORKPLACES (-29.4%), and PARKS (-29.7%) at t-0w indicates comprehensive mobility restrictions. This multi-domain constraint will prevent RETAIL_REC recovery over the next four weeks unless at least two of these three series recover simultaneously.
candidate_trigger: All three of TRANSIT, WORKPLACES, PARKS remain below -20%
evidence_refs: fact:All three series severely depressed at t-0w
failure_condition: At least two of TRANSIT, WORKPLACES, or PARKS recover by more than 20 percentage points in week t+1w, yet RETAIL_REC remains below -30%.
